scope: Independent read-only serial admission/frame identity/reset/authority review of the exact seven report-local motion RTL files. No independent execution of the peer behavioral proofs and no complete endpoint or physical qualification claim.

findings.finding: CMD transport publishes exactly12 signed32-bit words from bits128..511 with monotonically0..11 channels. Serial checker requires that exact order, resets transaction state at snapshot_start, poisons duplicated/out-of-order/overlapped words and requires all12 completed good bits with busyLOW.

Unsigned magnitude handles INT_MIN without signed abs overflow; magnitude above0x01000000 forces base_goodLOW even though multiplicand is25bits. Validated100..1023 high/low timing makes high+low+1 fit11bits; the shared shift/add product and2^32 comparison use36bits. Truncated upper timing bits cannot authorize because base_good separately rejects the full16-bit out-of-range words.

At accepted transaction completion, frame/frame_cs/frame_rates_good latch on the same clock after streamed CRC and length/timing guards. The state sees that stable tuple on the next clock. CMD admission is never credited to FB. A new transaction clears frame_rates_good and serial channel state; reset clears all good/authority flags.

This motion top consumes one-clock validated requests directly. It has no backpressure queue; physical frame spacing is hundreds of clocks beyond the11-cycle checker. Public structural queue semantics are a separate implementation and are not claimed by this motion stage.

A rejected physical transaction emits rejection metadata only for an actually captured six-byte header; exact magic/ABI/opcode matching can invalidate configuration, never authorize a request. Unknown headers, FB rate checks, poisoned/busy admission and transport frame_bad cannot admit UPDATE. Same-cycle state fault cut remains downstream of this admission predicate.

known_scope_limits: General IOL1/output-session authority remains explicitly disabled.
Full provider/safety qualification/event/page/HAL implementation and vendor fit remain separate gates.
Defensive timing rejection is root-approved bounded correction; host still owns negotiated drive/machine caps.
